title: An object extension's format and json_schema validation rules skip the regex and JSON-schema checks the object's own rules get
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvfX5bawZKtfa6u7j9

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up the #33154 implementer reported out of scope and its contract review confirmed by reading (record 6870963898 ③ on PR #33205).
Business reason: after #33154 an extension's expression-bearing validation rules are judged like the object's own, but a `format` rule's regex and a `json_schema` rule's schema carried by an extension are still not checked at `os build` or the publish door. An invalid pattern or schema is accepted in Studio and fails only when an end user saves a record.
Reader who acts: the owner of the regex and JSON-schema validation-rule checks in `packages/lint`.

## 维护者速读

对象扩展里 `format`（正则）和 `json_schema` 类型的校验规则，在发布门和 `os build` 都不检查正则或 schema 是否合法；对象自身的同类规则会检查。写错要到最终用户保存记录时才暴露。

## Expected

The regex and JSON-schema checks reach the `validations` an extension carries, with the same rule ids and locators the object's own rules get.

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open extension format json_schema validation` checked at filing. Related: #33154.

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
